links.outcome: Reproducibility of GPT-4o IOL recommendations across repeated runs
links.effect: Repeated testing showed significant instability in the model's responses (P = 0.026); GPT-4o ICC 0.378 versus human surgeons 0.359.
links.quote: However, repeated testing showed significant instability in the model's responses (P = 0.026).

links.outcome: GPT-4o IOL selection appropriateness versus high- and low-volume cataract surgeons
links.effect: Overall appropriateness of GPT-4o was significantly lower than that of human surgeons (37.84% vs. 72.14%, P = 0.001).
links.quote: The overall appropriateness rate of GPT-4o for IOL selection was significantly lower than that of human surgeons (37.84% vs. 72.14%, P = 0.001).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of GPT-4o's performance and consistency in intraocular lens selection for cataract surgery compared to human surgeons, without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
